default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win25cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win25cis_rule_9_1_4 }}
registry:
  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsFirewall\DomainProfile\Logging\LogFilePath:
    title: "9.1.4 | Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Domain: Logging: Name' is set to '%SystemRoot%\\System32\\logfiles\\firewall\\domainfw.log' | LogFilePath"
    exists: true
    value: '{{ .Vars.win25cis_domain_firewall_log_path }}'
    type: REG_SZ
    meta:
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 9.1.4
      NIST800-53R5:
        - SC-7
        - SC-7(5)
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion: Imported from role task file `tasks/section_9/section_9.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS` and Audit control `section_9/section_9.1/cis_9.1.4.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

odvs.description: win25cis_domain_firewall_log_path is the path to the domain firewall log files. The control suggests %SystemRoot%\System32\logfiles\firewall\domainfw.log This is a variable to give some leeway on where to store these log files
odvs.name: domain_firewall_log_path

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "9.1.4 | PATCH | Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Domain: Logging: Name' is set to '%SystemRoot%\\System32\\logfiles\\firewall\\domainfw.log'"
  when: win25cis_rule_9_1_4
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_9.1.4
    - patch
    - firewall
    - domain
    - NIST800-171_3.13.1
    - NIST800-171_3.13.5
    - NIST800-171_3.13.6
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-7
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-7_5
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsFirewall\DomainProfile\Logging
    name: LogFilePath
    data: '{{ win25cis_domain_firewall_log_path }}'
    type: string
